reason: The plan hits the length cap, rollback, dry run, backup-before-destructive-step, and stakeholder communication requirements, but the dedicated 'data integrity verification' step (8) occurs before the actual cutover (step 9), so the explicit post-cutover checksum/row-count check is only weakly represented as a secondary 'lightweight spot-check' inside the go-live step, partially undercutting that specific requirement.
